scope: Author-public MP4 primary; PNG diagnostic only

configuration.name: MagicBokeh DAVIS union-target depth-medoid point focus

authorization.user_quote: 批准上述完整规则，继续预检及全量
authorization.scope: Full rules in async approval: nonzero union including255; B single-click selection; fixed8 then42; same seed/preflight/full/resume; proceed after implementation checks

target.definition: Original palette-index annotation !=0, including ID255 exactly as the existing DAVIS v2 union mask. Not the Synthetic designated layer target.
target.resize: Read palette indices without grayscale conversion; INTER_NEAREST to1024x576, then labels!=0. RGB uses existing INTER_LINEAR original JPEG to1024x576 RGB uint8.
target.multiple_instances: Union all nonzero IDs; use B largest8-connected component each frame. Report component label-ID counts and per-ID focused coverage. A component can contain several touching instances; selected component/instance can change across frames. No manual easier-instance choice or guarantee of all instances sharp.
target.safe_region: Reuse safe_target_region: alpha>0.9, then>0.5, then>0; binary labels imply first threshold whenever nonempty. Largest8-connected component; equal area chooses earliest row-major component. Zero-padded exact Euclidean distance.
target.point: Reuse medoid_point: native own predicted PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties greatest exact boundary distance then row-major pixel.
target.unavailable: Stop and record blocking scene/frame if the prescribed union target is empty or invalid. Do not change targets, propagate, exclude, or fill a formal table with a subset.
target.permission: DAVIS annotation assists a single click outside the model; no GT numeric depth, GT alpha or target mask enters the generator. The native focus condition mask is computed from own predicted depth, not from annotation.

configuration.depth: Unchanged official DAdepth.pth ViT-L infer_image518; per-image minmax with1e-8; float32 depth truncated toPNG8.
configuration.focus: Own native quantized predicted depth at selected pixel /255; never reuse VDA numeric focus.
configuration.control: abs(own_PNG8_depth/255-focus)*K/32; native focused condition<=0.1; no VDA span compensation
configuration.generator: Frozen OfficialMagicBokeh FP16 weights/precision and original per-module training states;512x512 tiles stride256,6 calls per1024x576 frame, native GPU overlap assembly and PIL/AdaIN color handling unchanged
configuration.scene_order: These8 first in listed order; remaining42 in lexicographic order; fixed before any new output or VEPI
configuration.RNG: torch.manual_seed(42) before model loading; torch.manual_seed(42+25*fixed_scene_index+frame_index) immediately before6 native tile calls. Same preflight/full/resume; no temporal propagation or smoothing.
configuration.evaluation: Unchanged scripts/evaluate_davis_vepi.py with original data config, ROI, first25 frames and author entry. Primary VEPI-public-mp4; diagnostic VEPI-png and MP4-PNG; mean25 frames then equal-video mean50.
configuration.scope: Full50 quantitative baseline supplement only; no held-out failure discovery, viewing-based tuning, ATB page edits, other baseline reruns or efficiency reruns

runtime.precision: unchanged DAdepth native FP32 and generator FP16

limits: Annotation-guided own-depth single-click baseline; not automatic autofocus or shared VDA geometry
Union plus largest component can select one of several instances or switch components; coverage is recorded, not tuned
VEPI is foreground-edge preservation, not overall bokeh or temporal quality; no new visual judgments
Full50 quantitative supplement does not authorize held-out failure discovery or tuning
